name: Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Black Sequoia'
story_html: The Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Black Sequoia' outfits the lifestyle runner in subdued tones. Speckled rope laces secure the upper, crafted from dark green mesh with contrasting black overlays in synthetic nubuck and suede. Coated in a reflective finish, a Metallic Pewter Swoosh is stitched atop a black TPU midfoot cage. The sneaker rests on a solid black Cushlon midsole with responsive Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot and heel.
